summary: Examines a synchronization problem in SMTP that can cause a message to be delivered more than once, and suggests a way to avoid it. Some familiarity with the SMTP specification in RFC 821 is required.

eli5.summary: If a delivery person doesn't hear that the package arrived, they may bring a second copy. This memo shows how mail can end up sent twice and how to stop it.

questions: why do duplicate emails happen with smtp
how to avoid duplicate message delivery in smtp
